points.description: States that the collision domain diameter decreases by a factor of 10 (becomes one tenth, e.g. 300m to 30m). Equivalent wording accepted. Saying only 'decreases' without the factor of 10 does not earn the mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark for stating the diameter shrinks by a factor of 10 (one tenth). No mark for 'decreases' with no factor, or for increase/no change.
